Delhi Govt Extends Cashless Healthcare to DJB Pensioners

The Delhi government has extended its cashless healthcare facility to pensioners of the Delhi Jal Board (DJB) and their families. Chief Minister Rekha Gupta launched the initiative, which aims to provide hassle-free medical treatment.
